title: Porto and Sydney regionals: still no results online
detail: Searched Limitless again: its newest listed tournament is still dated 26 Jul 2026, so nothing from 7 Nov is visible yet. Winners and decks unconfirmed; we'll report when they appear.

title: OP-18 date still unsettled; Bandai's English page link now 404s
detail: Yesterday's Bandai page link returns 'not found' today, so the 20 Nov English date is unconfirmed. Retailers/Japanese sources still mix 20 and 22 Nov. Overseas shops (e.g. GameStop) already list OP-18 for pre-order, limited to one per account. Wait for Bandai before buying on a date.

title: Miyata Kard Market (Réunion): Delta Reign display and boosters back in stock
detail: Today's page shows in stock: Display 36 €239.99, Bundle of 6 €44.99 (was €49.99), single booster €7.99. Sold out: Elite Trainer Box €79.99 (was €89.99) and 3-pack €19.99. Yesterday only the bundle was available, so stock moves fast. The shop's stock counter says 5 in stock; check before going.

title: Flowing Fists (English ME7) date of 5 Feb 2027 is still unofficial
detail: Press coverage repeats 5 Feb 2027 for the English version of Aura Seeker, but at least one tracker says The Pokémon Company has not announced it. Treat as unconfirmed. No new official announcement found today.

title: Price checks skipped again today
detail: The collection file still has no TCGdex ids, so no 7-day vs 30-day comparison was run on your cards. Adding ids in a normal session would enable this.
